summary: End-to-end testing of KAZO Marketplace Finance & Reconciliation platform. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed covering auth, masters, uploads, calculations, reconciliation, dashboards. Frontend: login (pre-filled admin creds), overview KPIs, all 7 sidebar navigations, uploads page with upload/delete/run-calc buttons, all 6 masters tabs, sales ledger with calc drawer, calculations page with run-all button, reconciliation page with run button, discrepancies page with detail drawer — all verified working. Data integrity confirmed: 14,219 sales/calcs, ₹2.61Cr NSV, ₹1.95Cr expected settlement, 92 discrepancies detected with severity breakdown.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits warnings 'width(-1) height(-1) should be greater than 0' during initial render — likely due to chart being inside grid before layout settles. Non-blocking cosmetic warning.

action_items: Optional: suppress Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial width=-1 warnings by giving containers an explicit minHeight/minWidth or delaying render until layout is ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: current_user is loaded but most non-auth endpoints (masters/uploads/calculations/reconciliation/dashboards) are NOT protected by Depends(current_user). Any anonymous user with knowledge of URL can call them. Recommend adding a global router dependency or per-route Depends.

calculations.py: inside run_calculations, `_get_masters` result is loaded once (good), but per-row `find_one` on db.calculations for existence check makes recomputes O(N) round-trips. Better to fetch existing sales_ids into a set upfront when payload.recalculate=False.

reconciliation.py: `insert_many` mutates docs by adding _id; a snapshot is made for `discrepancies_sample` but the endpoint response after mutation would leak _id if returned directly (currently not returned in run body, so OK).
dashboards.py line 112: `by_component` uses `db.calculations.database.discrepancies` — works but is a confusing indirection; should use `db.discrepancies.aggregate` directly.
auth: login endpoint has no brute-force lockout / rate limiting despite auth_testing playbook requirement.

uploads_r.py: sales row rejection reason for '-' SKUs relies on missing SKU check; actually a literal '-' string passes validation. Confirm behaviour matches product intent (spec says '-' SKUs should be rejected).
Files >700 lines: none currently, all backend routers well-sized.
seed_data_creation: None (system already had 14,219 sales rows and 250 settlement rows from prior manual testing; test suite is idempotent — uploads sample files only if missing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (15/15). All frontend nav, drawers, tabs, forms wired with data-testids. Overview commission-summary KPIs load slightly after page mount — need >3s wait before screenshotting. Any UI test should use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env, not localhost.
